TL:DR: We should all be hurling our $25 at the one-man-team that gives us the greatest space sims ever made, even during the times that the genre was thought to be dead. A real diamond hiding in the rough.

This game(as well as previous StarWraith 3D Games titles) are still made by a single, and incredibly devoted man. He's been making these amazing games for 30 years, and they are frequently patched and improved. The graphics may not be quite on par with some other new titles, but the gameplay depth and physics put E:D, Star Citizen, and any other space sim title on the market to shame. These games also come with absolutely no DLC purchases. Pay once, play forever. I've been enjoying both Evochron Mercenary, and Evochron Legacy, and will continue to support SW3DG titles forever. For the $25 price tag(Legacy), or $20(Mercenary), you get countless hours of space exploration, combat, and trading fun. The learning curve appears rather steep, but after about 45 minutes in the tutorials(optional, but very very helpful) you will have no trouble finding your way around the immense universe. Planetary landing has been incorporated from day 1, as well as in Evochron Mercenary, and is done exquisitely, with a fully implemented atmospheric flight model. The way the developer has captured the nuances of craft optimized for flight in the vacuum of space attempting to fly in a dense atmosphere, with wind, weather, and gravity is so realistic and engrossing, you'll probably find yourself flying over the beautiful planet surfaces for hours on end, just for fun. I really can't speak highly enough of this game, as well as SW3DG's many other titles. In a genre that had died out for nearly 20 years, one man has made an incredibly strong effort in keeping it alive and well. Now with the massive flood of interest in the genre, and the countless new entries, his games continue to stand out proudly as the best of the best. This is a man that has more experience and time developing space sim games than the entire teams working on Star Citizen, E:D, No Man's Sky, etc, etc combined. He actively participates in his games' forums, takes feedback extremely well, and implements player-recommended changes with amazing rapidity. The graphics are really the only thing that can be rated lower than some other titles, but I assure you that if you try the COMPLETELY FREE DEMO(which is actually the entire game, playable for 90 minutes total, not including tutorial time) on the official website, you'll quickly feel so immersed in the realism and incredible features of the game that the graphics will start to look more like real life than real life itself. I really didn't intend to write more than a couple sentences, but I just couldn't help myself. Please do yourself a favor, play the demo. Help us bring this hidden gem to the forefront, where it truly deserves to shine as an example to all other space sims.

I don't know if I'd go as far as "the greatest space sims ever made", but it's definitely worth looking in to. Not sure too many people are going to see your writeup, this post is rather old. I'd strongly suggest you put your efforts in to newer threads.
